richiami.difetto: The starter inhibit signal can fail to communicate with the engine ECU. This results in the possibility that the engine may be started from the chassis controls with the cab tilted and the transmission in drive.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with an additional wiring harness which will prevent this occurring.
richiami.titolo: IT IS POSSIBLE TO START THE ENGINE WITH THE CAB TILTED AND THE VEHICLE IN DRIVE.

richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and inspect the heater cock. Should signs of leakage be detected the heater cock will be replaced.

richiami.difetto: The track rod adjuster in the track rod tube may not have been correctly positioned prior to clamping. This could result in the clamping force on the adjuster being insufficient. In the worst case detachment of the track rod could occur and cause a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Check the position of the track rod end adjuster and reposition it to comply with the specification where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: TRACK ROD ADJUSTER MAY NOT BE POSITIONED CORRECTLY.

richiami.difetto: The automatic slack adjuster lever may neck on the brake chamber push rod clevis connection.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles replace the brake chamber push rod with a shorter version renew the clevis connection and shorten the slack adjuster to prevent further fouling/necking.
richiami.titolo: SLACK ADJUSTER MAY NECK ON CLEVIS CONNECTION.

richiami.difetto: One or more heads of the top steering lever and tie rod arm securing bolts may detach. Multiple bolt failures could result in a loss of steering control.
richiami.modello: MERITOR STEER AXLE EQUIPED VEHICLES , MERITOR STEER AXLE EQUIPED VEHICLES
richiami.rimedio: Remove all suspect bolts and fit quality assured replacements.

richiami.difetto: The lower steering column shaft may be too short and in a worst case separate from the steering box input shaft.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles measure the length of the lower steering column shaft and replace where necessary.

richiami.difetto: One or more heads of the top and bottom steering lever securing bolts may detach resulting in a loss of steering control.
richiami.modello: MERITOR STEER AXLE EQUIPED VEHICLES , MERITOR STEER AXLE EQUIPED VEHICLES
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured replacement bolts.

richiami.difetto: First and second axle power steering ram front and rear ball joint taper fixing nuts may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check the fixing nuts for correct torque. Replace any parts damaged through looseness.

richiami.difetto: A batch of wheel studs from an outside supplier may have been incorrectly heat treated and could fail in service.
richiami.rimedio: The wheel studs on potentially affected vehicles are being replaced with quality assured examples.

richiami.difetto: A batch of wheel studs from an outside supplier may have been incorrectly heat treated and could fail in service.
richiami.rimedio: The wheel studs on potentially affected vehicles are being replaced with quality assured examples.

richiami.difetto: The steering box extension may have been omitted during build. In consequence the steering shaft could pull off the steering box when the cab is tilted resulting in loss of steering.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and where required fit the extension to the steering box. At the same time new clamp bolts and nuts will be fitted to the steering shaft assemblies.

richiami.difetto: The steering box extension may have been omitted during build. In consequence the steering shaft could pull off the steering box when the cab is tilted resulting in loss of steering.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and where required fit the extension to the steering box. At the same time new clamp bolts and nuts will be fitted to the steering shaft assemblies.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that a terminal on the starter solenoid may foul on the fuel injection pump causing a short circuit and a potential risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and reposition/rotate the starter solenoid on the engine mounting bracket to effect a non foul condition.
richiami.titolo: FOUL CONDITION BETWEEN STARTER SOLENOID AND FUEL INJECTION PUMP

richiami.difetto: Under certain operating conditions the front axle brake chamber clamp bolt could foul the brake pipe elbow fitting where it passes through the chassis frame.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and rotate the brake chamber clamp bolts through 90 degrees so that they are retained in the vertical position.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE CHAMBER CLAMP BOLT MAY FOUL FRONT BRAKE HOSE ELBOW CONNECTOR

richiami.difetto: Some braking system air pipes are routed in close proximity to the exhaust system tail pipe. In consequence heat radiation from the exhaust can cause pipe failure and unscheduled application of the spring brakes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and modify the air pipe securing arrangement to provide additional clearance between the pipes and the exhaust system.

richiami.difetto: The fixing nut and bolt which secures the steering column to the steering box is not to the correct specification.
richiami.rimedio: All subject vehicles to have the fixing nut and bolt replaced with quality assured items.
richiami.titolo: STEERING COLUMN FIXING BOLT OF INCORRECT SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: The steering box mounting bracket may crack.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering box mounting bracket with a modified example.

richiami.difetto: The steering column sliding connection may seize on its lower splines. This can cause vertical loading on the clamping bolts and eventually lead to steering failure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering column lower sliding shaft with a sealed for life version. The clamp bolts will also be renewed.
richiami.titolo: SEIZURE OF STEERING COLUMN COUPLING SLIDING SPLINE

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles have been fitted with chassis junction box connector blocks which are not to the manufacturer's specification. This can result in overloading of the negative link wires and loss of the negative circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall and examine all potentially affected vehicles to establish if they have been fitted with the incorrect connector blocks. Where identified these blocks will be replaced with quality assured versions.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that certain of the push in pipe connections on the braking system may detach resulting in unscheduled application of the brakes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the appropriate fittings with compression joints.
richiami.titolo: DISCONNECTION OF CERTAIN BRAKING SYSTEM PIPE FITTINGS

richiami.difetto: The air suspended/air operated driving seat may rise to its full height limit and remain in that position regardless of prior adjustment.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and modify the driving seat internal valve assembly to eliminate the possibility of the seat inadvertently rising.

richiami.difetto: The spot weld on the steering gear mounting bracket may prevent the flanged nuts on the bolts securing the bracket to the chassis frame from seating correctly. This could result in the bracket working loose from the chassis frame with an adverse affect
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and substitute Hex Clevelok nuts for the original flanged examples.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOOSENING OF STEERING BOX MOUNTING BRACKET

richiami.difetto: The bolts securing the steering box to its mounting bracket may not have been sufficiently torqued at initial assembly. This could result in eventual loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the steering box mounting bolts re-setting where necessary.

richiami.difetto: The bolts securing the steering box to its mounting bracket may not have been sufficiently torqued at initial assembly. This could result in eventual loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the torque of the steering box mounting bolts re-setting where necessary.
